issues.evidence: Tibetan 'myong ba ci phyir 'dzin ma yin' = why is the experience (of happiness etc.) not apprehended/grasped; Sanskrit 'saṃvittiḥ kiṃ na gṛhyate'. The Chinese '領受為體驗' introduces an unmotivated 'as' construction and a non-locked verb 領受, obscuring that 'dzin (grasp/apprehend) takes myong ba (體驗, locked) as its object (bo-kunpal 9-132: 'myong ba ci yi phyir 'dzin pa ma yin').

issues.span:
如是有法觀待他，
亦見有法不觀待
issues.evidence: Tibetan 'de bzhin 'ga zhig gzhan la ni / ltos dang ltos med pa yang mthong' = 'likewise some (thing) is seen to depend on another and also not to depend'; 'ga zhig' is indefinite 'something'. 有法 is the technical rendering of chos can (dharmin, property-bearer), which the Tibetan does not use here (cf. bo-kunpal 9-20 'gsal bya gsal byed', bo-shenga 9-20 'bum pa la sogs pa'i dngos po 'ga zhig').
issues.fix:
